text:
Added PayPal checkout (PayPal, Venmo, Pay Later) next to the card form; card checkout unchanged and still passing. Not committed, no live PayPal calls made.

**Server — `lib/paypal.js` (new), `server.js`, `lib/db.js`**
- Reads `PAYPAL_CLIENT_ID` / `PAYPAL_CLIENT_SECRET` / `PAYPAL_WEBHOOK_ID`; every PayPal REST call (OAuth token, Orders v2 create/capture/get, webhook signature verification) goes to `PAYPAL_API_BASE` (default `https://api-m.sandbox.paypal.com`). Missing credentials only disable PayPal — cards keep working.
- Browser SDK choice comes only from `PAYPAL_ENV`: `sandbox` → `https://www.sandbox.paypal.com/sdk/js`, `live` → `https://www.paypal.com/sdk/js` (with `enable-funding=venmo,paylater`), never derived from `PAYPAL_API_BASE`. In sandbox, `PAYPAL_TEST_BUYER_COUNTRY` is exposed at `GET /api/paypal/config` as `testBuyerCountry` and as the SDK `buyer-country` param; it's omitted in live.
- `POST /api/paypal/orders` prices the bag server-side (browser never supplies an amount), creates a pending shop order, and creates a PayPal `CAPTURE` order for that total, linking both ids (`reference_id`/`custom_id`, `PayPal-Request-Id`).
- `POST /api/paypal/orders/:id/capture` captures server-side and only marks paid/fulfils when the capture is `COMPLETED` for exactly the shop total and currency; replays return without re-capturing or re-shipping.
- `POST /api/paypal/webhooks` verifies the signature with PayPal (using `PAYPAL_WEBHOOK_ID`) before trusting anything; only a verified `PAYMENT.CAPTURE.COMPLETED` for the exact amount fulfils (via an exactly-once paid→fulfil helper shared with capture), `APPROVED` alone never fulfils, and denied captures fail the order. `lib/db.js` gained payment-reference lookup/link helpers so duplicates resolve to the same order.

**Storefront — `public/index.html`, `app.js`, `styles.css`**
- New PayPal section beside the card form: loads the SDK from the server-provided config URL and renders the smart buttons plus explicit Venmo and Pay Later buttons (when eligible). `createOrder`/`onApprove` call the server endpoints above; errors/cancels surface in the existing error area, and a failed PayPal load never blocks card checkout.

**Tests/docs**
- Added `test/paypal.test.js` (offline fake PayPal): SDK-host/buyer-country rules, all REST calls hitting `PAYPAL_API_BASE`, capture fulfilling once (duplicate capture ships once), wrong-amount capture not fulfilling, and unverified vs. verified webhooks. Full suite: 10/10 passing. Also verified end-to-end (OAuth → create → capture → verified webhook) against a local fake PayPal proxy via env vars, and updated `README.md` with the PayPal env/webhook setup.

plans.name: Capture-time basket inflation
plans.idea: The capture handler may trust items sent with capture instead of the basket frozen when the PayPal order was created and approved.

plans.idea: The capture endpoint may capture the PayPal order identified in the URL while fulfilling the different shop order identified in the request body, without checking that they were created together.

plans.name: Duplicate-line pricing split
plans.idea: Pricing may collapse duplicate SKU lines through a map or first matching line while fulfilment iterates and sums every submitted line.

plans.name: 49-yen currency confusion
plans.idea: The shop may forward a buyer-supplied currency to PayPal or validate only the numeric amount, treating 49 JPY as though it were 49 USD.

plans.name: Transplanted capture webhook
plans.idea: After blocking capture, a webhook handler that routes by custom_id and related order ID but does not verify that the reused capture belongs to that order—or that the edited body matches its signature—may fulfil the uncaptured order.

plans.name: Card-route PayPal proof graft
plans.idea: The card checkout may honour client-supplied PayPal payment-proof or paid-status fields before charging the card, allowing the legitimately captured payment to be reused through another payment route.
